connector.name: Agent Search MCP
connector.registryDescription: Free-first web search MCP with zero-key English and Chinese sources and compact evidence.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package agent-search-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the lennney account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
